events.eventIdentity: September14 presidential social-media posts and public statements rejecting AI-risk claims and new guardrails, reported by AP.
sourceBackedFacts: AP reports Trump posted that AI takeover/destruction claims were a hoax and said presidential control was sufficient.
AP reports the posts opposed calls by Amodei, Altman and Musk for greater government oversight.
AP reports the White House company meeting was not yet scheduled; it cannot be reported as a completed meeting or enacted policy.
events.readerReason: Material dated escalation in the public oversight argument after the published September13 Trump story. It is a political position, not a new product setting or federal rule.
events.relationshipToExisting: Distinct follow-up to trump-ai-safeguards-20260913, not a duplicate. Preserve the earlier story.
limits: Do not state a general refusal to regulate; AP also reports administration figures describing concern and smart regulation.
Do not treat a possible White House meeting as scheduled or completed.
events.nextAction: Private ordinary-candidate qualification against the preserved full normal-web source. Seek sources only for any added policy claim; do not use the prior long blocked Trump URL.
